message.content:
answer: Your look feels slightly disjointed because the milky boots create a visual gap at your feet and mute the natural line of your leg. Switching to beige boots would bridge that space seamlessly, making your silhouette feel taller and more intentional while keeping your upper body colors balanced.

verdict: wear_with_change
